title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist sanctuary with a three-storey vermilion pagoda, nine golden sorin rings, an irimoya worship hall, a suspended bell and a red moon bridge over koi and lotus. Compact stone foundations support the buildings; connected swept eaves, smooth bridge ramps and branch-supported maple crowns refine the original scene. The open hall reveals its golden altar, approached through stone lanterns and raked gravel.
